summary.text: Joe Palmer is a Republican who represents District 20 (Seat A) in the Idaho House of Representatives and is listed in a ninth term; the directory lists Palmer as self-employed.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's biography, Palmer is a fourth-generation Idahoan, was born and raised in the Treasure Valley and graduated from Meridian High School.
It says Palmer attended Ricks College, graduated from Boise State University and is a former member of the Idaho National Guard.
